## Expected and observed behavior

## Reproduction

Provide the command and a minimal synthetic or redistributable example.
Do not upload private human reads or credentials.

## Environment and identity

Include `esperanto --version`, executable SHA-256, platform, build flags and,
when relevant, resolved model hashes, reference/index identity and exit status.

## Evidence

Attach relevant logs and explain whether strict interface qualification failed.
